bullets.title: MDB: CEO Desai departs to META, stock -18%; interim CEO reinstated, investor day LT targets intact
bullets.body: CJ Desai resigned immediately to join META as Chief Enterprise Platform Officer, with founder Dev Ittycheria reinstated as interim CEO. MDB slid ~18-20% on the news despite the company reaffirming FY27 guidance and issuing 3-5yr targets at investor day: high-teens revenue growth, 20%+ operating margins with 100-200bps annual expansion, 80%+ FCF conversion. Citi calls it a buy-the-dip; DA Davidson sees near-term valuation overhang from loss of Desai's enterprise relationships.

bullets.title: META: Enterprise/Muse platform launch; SMB SaaS pressure; stock -5% on profit-taking
bullets.body: META launched Enterprise Platform (Muse, Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code) and Muse for Small Business with connectors to Asana, Zoom, Intuit, Slack. The SMB push hit HUBS -5.1% and WIX -5.7%. META stock pulled back ~8% over two days on profit-taking ahead of OpenAI DevDay despite Citi reiterating Buy at $800 PT; the Enterprise launch signals sufficient compute capacity into 2027.

bullets.title: NVDA: $150B buyback authorization; stock only +1.7% — weak catalyst follow-through flagged
bullets.body: NVIDIA announced a $150B share repurchase authorization bringing total capacity to $235B through FY28, and launched the Open Agent Safety Platform. Stock gained only 1.7% with failed zero-day call buying signaling weak follow-through. NVDA CEO also characterized model distillation as 'competition' rather than 'theft,' and the company has contracted 2.6GW of frontier AI lab capacity through 2028 with indirect contracted value exceeding $180B.

bullets.title: MRVL: MediaTek TPU delays a positive; investor day Oct 6 expected to raise 2030 targets to $15-20 EPS
bullets.body: MediaTek is unlikely to deliver Google TPU v8 samples in 2026 (pushed to 2Q27) due to tape-out failures and SerDes issues, and the Broadcom-MediaTek v9 collaboration has been cancelled. Google may shift v9 (with HBM4e) entirely to Marvell. MRVL investor day on Oct 6 expected to raise FY27/FY28 guidance ($12B/$18B already issued) and target $15-20 EPS by 2030 with 40%+ CAGR in AI infrastructure over three years.

bullets.title: AMD: Acquires Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2B, expanding into physical/robotics AI
bullets.body: AMD is acquiring World Labs for $8.2B with Dr. Fei-Fei Li joining as EVP and Chief Scientist. The deal strengthens AMD's competitive position vs. NVIDIA and accelerates its physical AI and end-to-end systems strategy. Bulls see the acquisition supporting a path toward $30 EPS in 2-3 years; Meta Muse also uses AMD EPYC 9D64/9D25 processors (2 vCPUs per agent user), providing an incremental CPU demand tailwind.

bullets.title: CCL: Strong 3Q beat; FY26 yield raised to +2.3%, Buy consensus; $36-37 PT at UBS/Citi
bullets.body: CCL reported record Q3 net yields of +2.4% YoY vs. guidance of +1.2% (120bps beat), adj EBITDA $2.99B vs. $2.88B guide, EPS $1.43 vs. $1.35 guide. FY26 net yield guidance raised 55bps to +2.3% (vs. Street +1.8%), FY26 EPS raised to $2.24 from $2.22 with $150M operational improvements offsetting a $150M fuel cost headwind. 2027 is ~50% booked at record occupancy/pricing; customer deposits hit a Q3 record of $7.6B (+7% YoY); $1.2B in buybacks YTD. UBS maintains Buy/$36 PT; Citi maintains Buy/$37 PT.

bullets.title: SHOP: Flagged as key Agentic commerce winner; +3% in Canadian trading; UBS Buy via Adyen ecosystem
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley sees SHOP as a primary beneficiary of the Agentic commerce theme with ~70% GMV penetration in Payments and high merchant stickiness via embedded KYC. SHOP monetizes transactions not impressions, providing a structural edge vs. META's ad model. Separately, UBS initiates digital asset coverage naming Adyen (which acquired Orb and Talon.One for embedded finance in Shopify ecosystem) as a Buy.

bullets.title: GLW: $3B+ multi-year AT&T fiber supply deal confirmed; +3.1% pre-market
bullets.body: Corning and AT&T entered a multi-year agreement valued at more than $3B for fiber and cable supply to expand U.S. connectivity. Morgan Stanley notes the deal is already baked into GLW's guidance. Stock was up ~3.1% in pre-market trading.

bullets.title: MU: F4Q26 earnings tomorrow; Street at $51.3B rev, 85.5% GM, $31.72 EPS; HBM/DDR5 dynamics in focus
bullets.body: Micron reports F4Q26 on Sept 30 with consensus revenue of $51.3B (above the $51B high-end guidance), gross margin of 85.5% (vs. 86% guidance midpoint), and EPS of $31.72 (vs. $31.00 guidance midpoint). Key investor focus areas: HBM3/HBM4 and DDR5 ASP trajectories, NAND ASP pace, server vs. client demand split, and FY27 capex (consensus $47.8B). Server memory demand continues to significantly outpace supply.

bullets.title: ACN: Q4 earnings Oct 1; consensus $18.03B rev, $3.18 EPS; options imply ~8.4% move
bullets.body: Accenture reports Q4 on October 1 with Street at $18.03B revenue (vs. guidance midpoint ~$18.1B) and EPS of $3.18. ACN has beaten revenue in 15 of 20 quarters and EPS in 18 of 20, but forward guidance has beaten in only 5 of 18. Stock is up +11.8% since June 17 vs. S&P +3.6%. Options imply ~8.4% move on print.

bullets.title: CRM: Agentforce adoption broadening but deployment sizes smaller than messaging implies; Outperform/$275 PT
bullets.body: Oppenheimer reiterates Outperform on CRM with $275 PT. Agentforce adoption is broadening with AI budgets available, but deployment sizes remain smaller than messaging suggests due to implementation complexity. Nearly half of surveyed customers are choosing data management providers outside the Salesforce ecosystem, with workflow disintermediation from LLM providers cited as the primary AI risk — not Salesforce replacement. Seat deflation bear case is visible in survey data.

bullets.title: HOOD: Mizuho raises PT to $140 on stronger Sept volumes across equities, options, and crypto
bullets.body: Mizuho updated HOOD model with equity volumes rising to $939B (vs. $765B prior), options contracts to $859M (vs. $689M), and crypto volumes to $47B. PT raised to $140, valuing HOOD at 19x FY27E revenue vs. current 15x trading multiple. FY27 revenue estimates up ~1%; NII declining to $424M in 3Q on rate dynamics.

bullets.title: ORCL: Invoked force majeure on Blue Owl data center; stock -11% w/w
bullets.body: Oracle invoked force majeure on a Blue Owl Capital data center project in New Mexico, triggering an 11% weekly decline in the stock. Citi volatility desk notes the event drove elevated IGV options activity, with the options market positioning bullishly on IGV at the 14th percentile skew.

bullets.title: NET: DA Davidson downgrades to Underperform citing AI competition eroding governance moat
bullets.body: DA Davidson downgraded Cloudflare to Underperform, arguing enterprises are seeing rapid ROI from frontier models for workflow automation, reducing reliance on governance/security layers. This is a similar thesis to the PATH downgrade issued simultaneously, where 60% of NNARR from AI products faces headwind from frontier model alternatives.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone 18 demand checks weaker in Hong Kong vs. iPhone 17 cycle
bullets.body: Channel checks show iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max resale prices in Hong Kong signaling weaker demand relative to the iPhone 17 cycle. China eSIM restrictions flagged as an additional potential constraint on dual-SIM adoption.

bullets.title: HPE/SNPS: Investor days tomorrow (Sept 30) — watch for guidance and LT financial targets
bullets.body: HPE hosts its investor day at 11:30 ET on Sept 30 (last FY guidance provided Sept 2 with Q3 earnings). Synopsys hosts at 13:00 ET on Sept 30 and has historically used investor meetings to provide long-term financial targets; last Q4/FY guidance was issued Aug 26.

bullets.title: AMZN/GOOGL/MSFT: Anthropic IPO filing discloses $518B cloud CapEx commitments; GOOGL $111B, AMZN $110B, MSFT $31B
bullets.body: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals $518B in planned cloud CapEx commitments over 7-10 years (~80% non-cancelable), with ~$111B allocated to Google, ~$110B to Amazon, and ~$31B to Microsoft. Bain Capital projects AI infrastructure spend reaching ~$1.5T by 2031, requiring ~$6T in annual revenue to justify.

bullets.title: VRT: Initiated Buy at Vertical Research Partners; added to BofA US1 list — pre-market +%
bullets.body: Vertiv received a Buy initiation from Vertical Research Partners and was added to BofA's US1 recommended list on Sept 29, with shares up in pre-market trading.

bullets.title: AVGO: MediaTek delays are net positive; UBS NDR recap call Friday Oct 2 with Tim Arcuri
bullets.body: With MediaTek unable to deliver Google TPU v8 samples in 2026 and the v9 Broadcom-MediaTek collaboration cancelled, AVGO is positioned to retain and potentially gain Google ASIC share alongside Marvell. UBS hosting an AVGO NDR recap call Friday Oct 2 at 7:30am ET with analyst Tim Arcuri to discuss Broadcom earnings takeaways.

bullets.title: Hedgeye Signal Strength: Key shorts TTD, APP, ORCL, CHTR; key longs SNOW, NET, MSFT, PLTR, NOW, META, AAPL
bullets.body: Hedgeye's fractal math signal-strength model flags 91 shorts and 66 longs on TRADE/TREND durations. Highest-conviction shorts include TTD, APP, DKNG, CHTR, ORCL; highest-conviction longs include SNOW, NET, TEAM, MSFT, PLTR, NOW, META, AAPL, DELL. Note: NET appears as a Hedgeye long at the same time DA Davidson downgrades it — conflicting views.
